qa.title: Q1562 (Sep. 19, 2025)
qa.question: If I can't select an engaged enemy follower on the field, can I still play this follower's Strike ability to give my leader +2 defense?

qa.title: Q1561 (Sep. 19, 2025)
qa.question: If an amulet that has become a follower via Maneuver has its attack or defense changed, does it retain those changes if its Maneuver ability is activated next turn?
qa.answer: No. When a card's Maneuver ability is activated, its attack and defense become the numbers listed.

qa.title: Q1560 (Sep. 19, 2025)
qa.question: If an amulet that has become a follower via Maneuver gains Aura, does it retain Aura when it returns to being an amulet at the end of the turn?

qa.title: Q1559 (Sep. 19, 2025)
qa.question: What does "Maneuver this card" mean?
qa.answer:
Maneuver is an ability that turns the card into a follower for that turn. Its attack and defense are listed on the card.

Similar to ordinary followers, a card that has been turned into a follower via Maneuver cannot attack on the turn it is put onto the field, unless it has Rush or Storm.

Cards that have been on the field for more than a turn can attack enemies as normal once Maneuvered.
